mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as accommodative policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative correlation with returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 4.5% instances, S&P 500 delivers positive 5-day returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate accelerating labor market contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through earnings uncertainty.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for 3 months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 3.5% periods, S&P 500 delivers positive 60-day returns in > 50% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumption expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1400 instances yield positive 20-day returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days through earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: Joint HOUST and RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 (index 2017=100) signals supply chain disruption, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 instances produce positive 5-day returns in > 40% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or positive correlation with returns is not significant (p > 0.05).
